title: Ada and the Hymn
author: Lior Dravenmoor
blurb: Mara Amberdale, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
